DIPLOMA IN
ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING

Learn the relationship between electrical power and electronic systems, from circuits and digital logic to control and communication.

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering

Published course update: 30 Nov 2022

OverviewEligibilityScope

Overview

Electrical and Electronics Engineering connects electronic devices and circuits with electrical power and control systems.

The BIT listing covers electrical fundamentals, electronics, digital logic, microprocessors, PLC, machines, appliance repair, power electronics, communication, industrial attachment and a major project.

Eligibility

All Nepalese and foreign candidates must meet CTEVT뭩 entrance requirements. Obtain the application form from BIT administration or an authorized centre, and pay the application fee set by CTEVT.

  • General stream: SEE / SLC passed or equivalent.
  • The original BIT guide lists TSLC aggregate marks of 66.66% from IOE and 68.33% from CTEVT.
  • Foreign students: two copies of a domicile certificate or passport.

These requirements are from BIT뭩 published course guide, dated 30 November 2022. Confirm the current intake criteria, entrance notice and documents with admissions before applying.

Scope

Explore technical work and further study in these areas:

  • Electronic system design
  • Device and system testing
  • Electronic system integration
  • Hardware design
  • Software for electronic devices
  • Communication networks
